serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Adobe Learning Manager (formerly Adobe Captivate Prime) is an award-winning cloud-hosted Learning Management System (LMS) that allows enterprise Learning and Development teams to drive personalized learning experiences for employees and partners of their organization across multiple devices. Adobe Learning Manager provides one learning platform to host, deliver, and track all agency education needs, from efficient onboarding to employee reskilling or compliance training at scale. Create customized learning with personalized experiences using training widgets and AI-powered intelligent learning recommendations based on profile data, skill group, peers, and other factors. Extensive APIs and Connectors provide the capability to seamlessly integrate with other enterprise applications like Zoom, LinkedIn, and Workday or bring in user information from HR systems. Adobe Learning Manager provides access to the best-in-class safety and security with Single Sign-On (SSO), 508, and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) compliance. With Adobe Learning Manager, agencies can take advantage of world-class streaming, step-by-step onboarding assistance, and 24 x 7 support with a dedicated Customer Success Manager. Learn more here. https://business.adobe.com/products/learning-manager/all-features.html
